authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: Platts p. 368 explicitly gives s̤ubūt, vernacular s̤abūt, with adjective entire. The existing Hindi s̤abūt whole/entire donor therefore supports these sabut responses. Regional transmission is provisional, without assuming direct Arabic borrowing by each survey language. Exact survey form sābūt is preserved.
